In simple terms, gravity is the invisible force that pulls two objects toward each other. The bigger an object is, the stronger its gravitational pull. That’s why we stay on the ground instead of floating off into space—Earth’s gravity is pulling us toward its center. The same force keeps the Moon orbiting Earth and Earth orbiting the Sun. It’s like an invisible string connecting everything in the universe, always working to bring things closer together.

That is gravity.
